node.statement: The ambient-algebra premise for monotonicity does not come from the recorded field epsilon_J^out. Instead node 1.1.2.2.1 identifies A_J=A, while the root hypothesis supplies that this same A is a finite-dimensional extended epsilon-C*-algebra. The Stage-3 current reset state supplies only the extended d_J^out-isomorphism tag. Therefore, after the codomain identification A_J=A, lem-maincb-extended-inclusion-monotone applies to v with the ambient-algebra parameter epsilon and with 0<=d_J^out<=W.c0_cb*W.K_call*epsilon; it yields the required extended W.c0_cb*W.K_call*epsilon-isomorphism without asserting that A_J is extended epsilon_J^out-C*.
